projects.title: Loan Rule Engine — Multi-Tenant Automated Loan Decisioning & Document Extraction

overview.paragraph: Built a multi-tenant BRE–CRE platform that automates the loan journey from document upload to bank recommendation. Users upload loan-related documents sequentially, while Rust-based document engines extract required information automatically. The FastAPI BRE–CRE engine processes eligibility rules and recommends suitable banks without manual form filling.
bullets: Built a Next.js multi-tenant loan platform with secure tenant isolation and challenge-based authentication.
Developed Rust document-processing engines and automated document-to-data pipelines, eliminating manual form filling.
Built a FastAPI BRE–CRE recommendation engine with configurable bank eligibility rules for multi-bank loan recommendations.
Designed a scalable, modular architecture supporting multiple tenants, banks, and loan products.
Implemented data ingestion and normalization services for multi-format financial data.
Enforced strict data isolation, audit logging, and role-based access across multi-tenant lending institutions.

steps: Document Upload → Sequential multi-format loan file ingestion
Rust Engine Extraction → Automated document-to-data pipeline without manual entry
Data Normalization → Ingestion & normalization of applicant financial data
FastAPI BRE-CRE Engine → Configurable bank rule execution & multi-bank matching
Tenant & Security Layer → Challenge-based auth & isolated multi-tenant architecture
Recommendation Delivery → Tailored bank approval recommendations & tracking

tools: Parsing Engines: Rust Document Processing Engine
impact: Eliminated manual form filling by implementing automated Rust-based document-to-data extraction.
Automated end-to-end loan evaluation with dynamic multi-bank rule decisioning.
Delivered robust multi-tenant data isolation with challenge-based authentication.

projects.title: OCR Handwritten Text Extraction — Bank Deposit Forms

overview.paragraph: Designed and implemented a high-accuracy handwritten OCR system for bank deposit forms by integrating computer vision, object detection, and transformer-based OCR models.
bullets: Built an end-to-end OCR pipeline using YOLOv8, OpenCV, Roboflow, and Hugging Face models to extract handwritten and printed fields from structured bank deposit forms.
Used YOLOv8 for precise field-level detection (account number, amount, date, depositor name, PAN, etc.), ensuring region-specific OCR instead of full-image extraction.
Prepared and managed annotated datasets using Roboflow, enabling efficient labeling, augmentation, and version control for OCR training.
Applied OpenCV preprocessing techniques (grayscale conversion, noise removal, thresholding, perspective correction) to improve handwriting clarity and OCR confidence.
Integrated Hugging Face Transformer-based OCR models (handwritten text recognition) to extract text with high accuracy and consistency.
Implemented confidence filtering and validation logic to reject low-confidence predictions and improve overall reliability.
Structured extracted data into JSON / database-ready formats for downstream processing and validation.
Optimized the pipeline for real-world banking scenarios, handling variations in handwriting styles, lighting conditions, and form alignment.

steps: Image Input → Bank deposit form scan/photo
Preprocessing → OpenCV (denoise, threshold, alignment)
Field Detection → YOLOv8 (trained via Roboflow annotations)
Text Recognition → Hugging Face handwritten OCR model
Post-processing → Confidence scoring, validation, formatting
Output → Structured digital data for banking workflows

tools: Output Formats: JSON, CSV, Database-ready schemas
impact: Achieved high-confidence handwritten text extraction suitable for financial documents.
Reduced manual data entry and verification effort.
Built a scalable OCR framework adaptable to other structured forms.

Designed a scalable URN-based architecture with dynamic frontend routing for seamless tenant and project management.
Built visual drawing comparison tools and annotation workflows with sub-second rendering performance.
Integrated PostgreSQL for multi-tenant drawing metadata, layer properties, and project versioning.
Delivered modular Next.js frontend and FastAPI backend microservices for enterprise construction teams.
